text:
Store credit is issued **instantly** and never expires.

For comparison, if you took the refund to your original payment method instead, it would take 5-10 business days for cards or 3-5 business days for digital wallets. Refunds always go back to the original payment method, never to a different card.

If your order was paid with buy-now-pay-later, the refund goes to the instalment provider rather than to you directly, and they adjust your remaining payments.
